title: Shoe Box + Wall Pack
headline: Replaces up to 400W HID.
intro: Retrofit almost any shoe box or wall pack fixture to energy & maintenance saving LEDs. Eliminate ballast failures. FlexColor on several models allows for less stocked inventory as well as field adjustability.
